body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work**; equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT rejected — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art. Stairs/grand/wide/ladders rotatable; elevator NOT. Risers: host-mod linked atlases, no custom art.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 3 — BUILT (compile green), awaiting in-game check
### Robots++ cross-level work (user report: base Misc Robots works, Robots++ doesn't)
Root cause: Robots++ ships NO code — just defs on base AIRobot classes. Their custom `X2_JobGiver_Work` think node scans ONLY the robot's own map and never runs vanilla JobGiver_Work (where our Tier1/2 migration lives). Base HAUL bots crossed levels anyway because their enumerator picks up our haul WorkGiverDefs (self-contained cross-level givers in Hauling); Robots++ construction/mining/etc. bots had no such giver -> idle forever. Fix in ABMiscRobotsCompat: postfix `X2_JobGiver_Work.TryIssueJobPackage` (by-name, DeclaredMethod) — NoJob result -> collect the robot's own work types via reflection-invoked `GetWorkGivers(false)` (skipping our own cross-level givers), gate on `LevelWorkSummary.Plausible(target, workType)` per linked level, stairs job toward a hit (`new ThinkResult(job, __instance, JobTag.Misc)`). Guards: 900t per-robot cooldown, LowPowerWorker, crossLevelWork toggle, ABGuard.Movement, robotType.IsInstanceOfType. Return trip = existing verified return routing.
### Forced cross-level construction with materials in hand (user report: can't right-click-order building on another level unless materials already there)
Root cause: our float-menu wrapper generates vanilla options with the pawn virtually ON the target level — deliver-resources finds no materials there -> disabled "need materials" option; storage across levels never reads connected. Fix: **ABConstructSupply.AddOption** (Logistics/ConstructSupplyOrder.cs), called from CrossLevelOrders.BuildOptions after WrapOptions (cross-level, pawn-not-on-target only): clicked cell resolves (same ScreenToBelowPos transform) to a player Blueprint/Frame (never Blueprint_Install) with `ThingCountNeeded > 0` for a def the TARGET level lacks (spawned+unforbidden check) but the pawn's level can spare (ExportAllowed + PawnCanAutomaticallyHaulFast forced) -> adds "Bring {material} and build {thing}" (MenuOptionPriority.High, keyed AB_BringMaterialsAndBuild). Action: playerForced AB_HaulAcrossLevels (count = min(needed, stack, capacity)) + ABPendingOrders continuation **FinishOnSite**: drop carried (spawns the stack; the ordered job clears the transfer's queued generic store job), re-resolve giver by CURRENT state (Frame vs Blueprint — may convert mid-climb), `giverDef.Worker.JobOnThing(pawn, constructible, forced: true)` -> pawn delivers own load and builds. Follow-up loads via supply giver + demand hauling. Multi-def costs: first missing def per order.

## BIOME-DRIVEN SKY PLATEAUS (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting check
Flora/regrowth/weather were already biome-driven via inherited PrimaryBiome; fixed the one hardcode: plateau arable band Soil -> `ArableTerrainFor(map.Biome)` via terrainsByFertility@0.7 with most-fertile-band + Soil fallbacks. Vanilla identical; modded biomes (Ashlands/ReGrowth/MVB) get native soil. terrainPatchMakers deliberately not applied. Modded-biome verification needs a session with the biome mod + matching tile.

## JOB-SCAN SETTINGS TAB — BUILT 2026-07-23, awaiting check
6th tab: presets Relaxed/Default/Eager/Frantic -> sliders jobProbeBudget/jobEmptyScanCooldown/jobMigrationCooldown/jobCacheTtl; flow checkboxes supplyConstruction/supplyBills/supplyMeals/fetchFromOtherLevels. All former consts settings-driven. Blueprint.SpawnSetup postfix -> instant work+demand cache invalidation.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 2 — BUILT, partial check (run with Achtung companion; robots gap found -> tranche 3)
Achtung formation drags (Colonist.OrderTo prefix); meditation redirect (assigned spot/throne in column); construction supply giver (WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction, Construction type).

## ART TUNER — BUILT: DEV gizmo, live drawSize/offsets, Bake -> Tools/ArtTuning.xml (fold-in pending).
## CLIMB/EMERGE ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS — BUILT: procedural Root-node workers; ladders rung-bob; elevators excluded; wide 2x1 stairs.
## TEXTURE / ROTATION REWORK — user stair art dropped, tuning pending. WATCH: no magenta stubs for foreign texPaths.
## MECH ESCORT FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting check.
## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62; caches settings-driven; event invalidation designations+blueprints.
## MISC. ROBOTS BASE — USER-VERIFIED run #62 (haul below + return/dock). Robots++ extension in tranche 3.
## SETTINGS SUITE — six tabs, measured scrolls, presets, ABGuard panel, gen preview, Odyssey landmarks.
## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED). COMPAT verified: sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode.
## PARITY COMPLETE; pod transit + AA verified #39.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + **Robots++ work migration (NEW, untested)**. Achtung! formation drags (soft, untested). Modded-biome sky plateaus (untested in modded biome). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: tranche 3 built — Robots++ work-think-node migration + bring-materials-and-build order. Awaiting combined test (suggest companions: Misc Robots + Robots++ [+ Achtung]). Outstanding: art bake fold-in, brainstorm levers (bill-supply giver, pressure scaling, overlay), mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
